insights.title: Working on this app makes my cry
insights.description: This isn't how my brain works, it doesn't flow right and the colors make my head hurt
insights.ai_summary:
**Insight:** Users find the current interface confusing and visually overwhelming.

**Key Findings:**
- Users struggle with the layout and flow of the interface.
- The color scheme is causing discomfort and distraction.

**Implications for UX Designers:**
- **Simplify Navigation:** Redesign the layout to follow a more intuitive and logical flow that aligns with user expectations.
- **Improve Color Scheme:** Choose a color palette that is visually soothing and accessible. Consider using tools like color contrast checkers to ensure readability and comfort.
- **User Testing:** Conduct further user testing to gather specific feedback on what aspects of the current design are problematic and how they can be improved.
